### Step 3: Compute the Difference

We now compute the **difference in position** of 'O' between shuffle 0 and shuffle 7:

$$
\text{Difference} = | \text{Position after shuffle 7} - \text{Position after shuffle 0} | = |6 - 2| = 4
$$

However, upon reviewing the **final frame** (frame 22), which shows:

\boxed{6}
